title: Nasruddin's Age (The Consistent Sage)
summary: When asked his age, Nasruddin replied: "I am forty years old."...
full_text:
When asked his age, Nasruddin replied: "I am forty years old."

"Mulla," cried the clerk, "you said you were forty years old ten years ago!"

"Of course!" said Nasruddin. "A true gentleman stands by his word; I am not a fickle man who changes his age with every passing breeze!"
moral: Consistency in words is a virtue, even when calendars disagree.
